sources.entry: Typemill - Author-friendly flat-file-cms with a visual markdown editor based on vue.js. (Source Code) MIT PHP

summary.one_liner: Typemill is an open-source, flat-file PHP content management system for building websites and eBooks from markdown files, with no database required.
summary.what_it_does: Typemill stores content as markdown files rather than in a database, and is aimed at informational sites such as user manuals, documentation, knowledge bases, wikis, and handbooks. It offers a visual block editor and a raw markdown editor for authors. It is built on Slim PHP, Vue.js, and Tailwind CSS, with Twig templates, a Symfony event dispatcher, and YAML definitions for developers. The README says it can extend through plugins, themes, and custom eBook layouts. An eBook plugin is described as converting content to PDF and ePUB from the same source.
use_cases: publish a documentation site from markdown files
build a knowledge base or wiki
create an eBook or handbook in PDF and ePUB
run a flat-file website without a database
write content in a visual markdown editor
how_to_run: Download and unpack the latest ZIP from the Typemill website, then upload all files to your server
Visit www.your-typemill-website.com/tm/setup and create an admin user
Alternatively: git clone the repository, then run composer update to install libraries
Or use the official Docker image from DockerHub
notable: Single source publishing to PDF and ePUB via the eBook plugin
Visual block editor plus raw markdown editor
Lightweight, about 2MB gzipped per the README
caveats: Requires PHP 8.1 or higher and a web server with mod_rewrite and several PHP extensions
Plugins, themes, and services are published under MIT and commercial licenses, so some extensions may be paid
Security issues are reported by email rather than a public tracker
